test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark (?) in the following equation?

(sqrt{785} + 72 ÷ 4 × 3 - sqrt{120}) × 2 = ?
solution:
**Given:**

√785 + 72 ÷ 4 × 3 - √120) × 2 = ?

**Formula used:**

√a + b × c - √d) × e = ?

**Calculation:**

√785 ≈ 28.02

72 ÷ 4 = 18, 18 × 3 = 54

√120 ≈ 10.95

Now substitute these values back into the expression:

(28.02 + 54 - 10.95) × 2

⇒ 28.02 + 54 = 82.02

⇒ 82.02 - 10.95 = 71.07

⇒ 71.07 × 2 = 142.14

**The approximate value of the expression is 142.**
